name: linux-headers-4.19.88-2
purpose: The Linux UAPI headers the C++ runtime's build includes for its linux-musl triple (plan step S4): libc++'s atomic waits include <linux/futex.h> and call SYS_futex, which the libc's dispatch serves over kernel events. sabotage-linux's sanitized headers of kernel 4.19.88, the set musl-cross-make uses, by the SHA-256 of the release tarball; only generic/include and the asm directories of x86 and arm64 are extracted, and only the runtimes' build sees them, never a program.
